cities.name: Ennerdale

cities.name: Accra
cities.scope: Partial Accra Metro publisher app-PID footprints, 12,586 rows / 12,582 native PID groups. Four repeated PID groups have disjoint parts with matching parcelcode. This is app identity, not claimed legal cadastral identity. Official authority and source update year unconfirmed; WUP center is outside the dataset extent.

cities.name: Mboloko
technicalBlockers: GISCOE bounded cells were complete, but all-target exact-ID acceptance did not finish. The sampled repeated SG21KEY has valid disjoint parts; its complete read takes about 22.7 seconds and exceeds the existing 15-second browser request deadline. Smaller batches also timed out.
cities.nextStep: Find a faster complete native-ID route or an alternate source; preserve the native code and all of its components.

cities.name: New Delhi
technicalBlockers: The complete e-Dharti snapshot has conflicting geometry for both published IDs and their pair. No alternate durable key was found; the officially linked Revenue GIS viewer timed out.
cities.nextStep: Revisit the Revenue GIS route or a publisher-documented disambiguating identity; retain the known L&DO conflicts.

cities.name: Pune
technicalBlockers: The current official Maharashtra map routes time out or redirect-loop. The historical WKT sample does not establish current native-ID reads, CRS or complete viewport retrieval.
cities.nextStep: Retry the documented BhuNaksha/e-Maps route when reachable and verify current coordinates, exact native IDs and complete map cells.

implementation.sharedComponentRule: Native groups retain all disjoint parts, require matching references, reject overlaps over one square centimetre. No transport OID becomes parcel identity.
implementation.johannesburgProfile: 25-record geometry pages, 80-key native batches, six concurrent queries; six actual app-sized cells completed within the existing 15-second browser deadline.
implementation.accraProfile: Bounded public POST selecting only parcelid and parcelcode; 8 MiB / 20,000-feature caps; complete in-memory snapshot before any bbox/exact/footprint query; five-minute existing cache.
